نستوء (form X)
# نَسْتَوْءِ (nastawʔi) /nas.taw.ʔi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَوْأَى (istawʔā) and اِسْتَوْءَى (istawʔā)
# نُسْتَوْءَ (nustawʔa) /nus.taw.ʔa/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of اِسْتَوْأَى (istawʔā) and اِسْتَوْءَى (istawʔā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
